headline: Brazilian Central Bank Expected to Pause Selic Rate Cuts
summary: Most banks and analysts expect the Central Bank of Brazil to pause its Selic interest rate cutting cycle, though a minority still anticipate further reductions.
why: Changes or pauses in the Selic benchmark rate dictate domestic lending costs, bond yields, and asset valuations across Brazilian financial markets.

impacts.name: Brazil Selic rate
impacts.why: A pause in the rate-cutting cycle maintains existing benchmark borrowing costs.
